clinical_design: Resected primary colon tumors; stage II-III used for adjuvant outcome analysis
available_label_counts: 566 tumor profiles in commonly used cohort; 469 stage II-III in one 2024 table; 460 stage II-III with relapse data and 417 with relapse+mutation data in another curated analysis; published treated subsets n=142,202,210
follow_up_or_response: Stage II-III all-treatment aggregate: 139 relapses,322 no relapse,8 missing; median follow-up 48 months (range 0-201) in 2024 summary; treated-subset event cross-tab not verified
adjustment_audit: Stage, site, MSI/MMR and ACT have been used in published analyses; CMS needs a fixed classifier/label map; treated event count may limit full adjustment
prior_work: Marisa six subtypes; CMS/ACT benefit analyses; multiple recurrence signatures; 2024 10-gene ACT-benefit signature
decision: Conditional primary clinical discovery after patient-level phenotype table audit
caveat: Numbers vary by endpoint, treatment/regimen, and missingness filters; baseline tumor is not a post-treatment residual sample

clinical_design: Unresectable CRC before mFOLFOX6; primary and metastatic samples mixed
available_label_counts: 83 patients; 42 responders and 41 non-responders; original split 54 train /29 test
follow_up_or_response: CT response after 4 cycles mFOLFOX6; no direct adjuvant recurrence, ctDNA or MRD endpoint
adjustment_audit: Must account for primary vs metastasis and sampled site; MSI/CMS not verified in public series summary; stage variation limited by unresectable design
prior_work: Original random-forest 15-probe response signature; multiple later FOLFOX predictors and Treg-response analysis
caveat: Disease setting and response endpoint differ from postoperative recurrence; no claim of residual cell persistence

clinical_design: Stage III primary tumors before adjuvant chemotherapy; extreme-outcome selection
follow_up_or_response: Favorable: recurrence-free >=5 years after chemotherapy; unfavorable: recurrence within 3 years; no intermediate cases
adjustment_audit: Stage fixed at III; n=24 is insufficient for multivariable adjustment; MSI/CMS/site fields not verified in public summary
prior_work: 108 transcript changes; PNN/KCNQ1OT1 proposed and validated by original study
caveat: Selected extremes; not a continuous prospective cohort; not independent for PNN/KCNQ1OT1
